morocco.urgencyStatement: 3 million street dogs targeted before FIFA World Cup 2030

stories.tierheimSevilla: Hunting season has ended, and with it, 14 Galgos were abandoned by their owners. These gentle sighthounds are now recovering at Tierheim Sevilla, where your subscriptions fund premium food. Each bag helps them heal—physically and emotionally—before finding their forever homes.
stories.antalyaRescue: Turkey's new law threatens mass culling of street dogs. Antalya Rescue is racing against time to protect 473 dogs and 73 cats. In December alone, MIRA resellers funded 312 kg of food—keeping these animals alive while we fight for their future.
stories.targuJiuRefuge: Last month, 23 dogs were pulled from Târgu Jiu's public shelter—a place where unclaimed animals face a grim fate. Now safe at the refuge, they depend on steady food supplies. Every 12 kg subscription funds one neutering, breaking the cycle that fills these shelters in the first place.
stories.marrakechAnimalAid: 3 million street dogs are targeted before FIFA World Cup 2030. Marrakech Animal Aid is working tirelessly to protect and care for street dogs in the region, providing food, medical care, and finding forever homes.
stories.giurgiuStreetCats: Managing street cat colonies requires consistent feeding and neutering programs. Giurgiu Street Cats works with local communities to care for approximately 200 cats across multiple colonies, ensuring they are fed and healthy.
